Six weeks after the announcement of the engagement, he died unexpectedly during a pandemic.

A list of all members of the house of Windsor is at List of members of the House of Windsor.. As of 2026[update], George V has 6 children, 9 grandchildren, 22 great-grandchildren and 52 great-great-grandchildren.
Thought 4: Thought 4: The observation confirms that George V and Mary of Teck had children. Since Mary of Teck outlived George V, and they had children, it is highly probable that one of their children became king, making her queen mother. I need to confirm that one of her children became king.
Action 4: Search[Edward VIII]
Observation 4: Edward VIII (Edward Albert Christian George Andrew Patrick David; 23 June 1894 – 28 May 1972), later known as the Duke of Windsor, was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from 20 January 1936 until his abdication in December of the same year.[a]. Edward was born during the reign of his great-grandmother Queen Victoria as the eldest child of the Duke and Duchess of York, later King George V and Queen Mary. He was created Prince of Wales on his 16th birthday, seven weeks after his father succeeded as king. As a young man, Edward served in the British Army during the First World War and undertook several overseas tours on behalf of his father. The Prince of Wales gained popularity due to his charm and charisma, and his fashion sense became a hallmark of the era.
Thought 5: Thought 5: Edward VIII was the eldest child of King George V and Queen Mary (Mary of Teck). He became King upon his father's death in 1936. Mary of Teck was still alive at this time. Therefore, she was the mother of the reigning king, making her the Queen Mother. The claim states she was *never* queen mother, which is refuted by this information.
